name: jacky_jonathan_lai_ats
description: Single column, black on white, for Jonathan Lai. Built for parsing: one column so the reading order cannot break, a real separator between every pair of fields on a line, ordinary section headings in the order summary, education, skills, experience, bullets as a list, and no icons, tables, fills or colour.
htmlContent:
{{name}}
{{title}}
{{contact.phone}} | {{contact.email}}{{#if contact.linkedin}} | {{contact.linkedin}}{{/if}}{{#if contact.github}} | {{contact.github}}{{/if}}{{#if contact.portfolio}} | {{contact.portfolio}}{{/if}} | {{contact.location}}
Professional Summary
{{summary}}
Education
{{#each education}}
{{degree}}
{{institution}}{{#if location}} | {{location}}{{/if}} | {{startDate}} - {{endDate}}{{#if gpa}} | GPA: {{gpa}}{{/if}}
{{/each}}
Technical Skills
{{#if skillCategories.[0].category}}{{#each skillCategories}}
{{category}}
{{join skills ", "}}
{{/each}}{{else}}{{#if hardSkills.length}}{{#each hardSkills}}{{this}}{{#unless @last}}, {{/unless}}{{/each}}{{else}}{{#each skills}}{{this}}{{#unless @last}}, {{/unless}}{{/each}}{{/if}}{{/if}}
Professional Experience
{{#each experience}}
{{title}} | {{company}}
{{startDate}} - {{endDate}}{{#if location}} | {{location}}{{/if}}
    {{#each achievements}}
  • {{this}}
    • {{/each}}
{{/each}}
{{#if certifications.length}}
Certifications
{{#each certifications}}
{{name}}{{#if issuer}} | {{issuer}}{{/if}}{{#if date}} | {{date}}{{/if}}
{{/each}}
{{/if}}
